concept_name.description: Short snake_case identifier for the lifted interaction/nonlinear mechanism basis.

python_expression.description: Pure vectorized numpy/scalar mathematical expression over the named input columns `x['<col>']` (allowed functions: `np.tanh`, `np.exp`, `np.log1p`, `np.sqrt`, `np.abs`, `np.sin`, `np.cos`, `np.maximum`, `np.minimum`, arithmetic `+ - * / **`). Must NOT reference target `y` or task IDs.

mechanistic_rationale.description: Concise scientific explanation of why existing additive/single-feature branches miss the residual pattern and how this lifted conduit resolves it.

domain_guard_note.description: Domain/extrapolation condition under which this lifted conduit remains bounded and physically meaningful.
